title: Common
description: Definitions shared by the midstudy HTTP API schemas (contract §2, §4.4). Not a payload itself.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Ids, layout and scene names (CLAUDE.md conventions).

jpegDataUri.title: JpegDataUri
jpegDataUri.description: A JPEG as a base64 data URI (contract §2.6). The server stores and sends it without its metadata.

pngDataUri.title: PngDataUri
pngDataUri.description: A PNG as a base64 data URI.

publicCalib.title: PublicCalib
publicCalib.description: calib.json as the API serves it (contract §4.4): never the camera's make or model (exif.make, exif.model stay on disk), never the stdout-only ok key.
